about.heading: About me
about.body: I'm a DevOps Engineer with hands-on experience in containerized infrastructure, CI/CD automation, and monitoring. I focus on turning manual, fragile deployment processes into reliable, observable, automated systems. I'm currently working full-time as a DevOps Engineer while building out my freelance practice on Upwork.

projects.title: Home Lab Infrastructure Stack
projects.description: A full Docker Compose stack — Nginx reverse proxy, MySQL, Node.js backend, static frontend — with multi-network isolation, healthchecks, resource limits, log rotation, and a complete Prometheus + Grafana monitoring layer.

projects.title: GitLab CI/CD Pipeline Lab
projects.description: End-to-end CI/CD pipeline for a multi-service app: Angular 19 frontend, Spring Boot microservices, Kafka (KRaft mode), and MySQL — covering builds, tests, and containerized deployment.

projects.title: Service Booking Platform
projects.description: A full-stack service booking platform (Laravel, MySQL, Tailwind) where clients book services from providers, with authentication, booking workflows, and a visitor-analytics dashboard.

experience.description: Docker Compose, monitoring (Prometheus/Grafana, CheckMK), GitLab CI/CD, Ansible/AWX, and Linux administration.
Independent projects covering infrastructure setup, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring stacks for clients.
